frontmatter.name: release
frontmatter.description: Automate version bump, git tag, and push for release

frontmatter.name: verify-all
frontmatter.description: Run all checks and tests (TypeScript, Svelte, Rust) in one command

frontmatter.name: triage
frontmatter.description: Plan and label the Margin repo's open GitHub issues and answer new comments, via the triager agent. Use when the owner asks to plan issues, check the tracker, reply to comments, or invokes /triage. Pass "watch" to keep watching for new activity.

frontmatter.name: triager
frontmatter.description: Plans and labels open GitHub issues of the Margin repo and answers new comments, without touching code. Use to prepare issues for implementation (posts a "## Plan" comment, flags owner decisions) or to watch the tracker for a while. Read-only on the codebase.

frontmatter.name: reviewer
frontmatter.description: Read-only second opinion on newly planned issues of the Margin repo (pass a list of issue numbers; one run per triage pass). Reads the triager's plan against the real code and posts one comment per issue (duplicate, already done, too vague, risky, or ready to build). Use from the triager's pass; never builds or closes anything.

frontmatter.name: ideator
frontmatter.description: Read-only idea generator for the Margin repo. Scans the whole product (README, features, settings, tests) and files up to 5 `idea` issues per run for small improvements, S/M features, missing tests and bugfixes, so the work queue doesn't run dry. Run by /autopilot when the queue is empty.

frontmatter.name: ship
frontmatter.description: Coordinate parallel work on the Margin repo — pick approved GitHub issues, run implementer agents in worktrees (default 3 at a time), shepherd open PRs to a merge, file follow-ups, clean up, report. Use when the owner says "ship", "work through the issues", "continue with the roadmap", or invokes /ship.

frontmatter.name: implementer
frontmatter.description: Implements one planned GitHub issue of the Margin repo end to end in its own worktree — code, tests, PR, CI, rebase, squash-merge. Use for issues labelled `approved`, ones the triager and reviewer agreed are small and clear, or ones explicitly assigned by the owner. Pass the issue number and any extra scope notes in the prompt.

frontmatter.name: pr-shepherd
frontmatter.description: Reviews an open PR of the Margin repo for correctness bugs, fixes real ones with tests, rebases onto main, waits for CI and squash-merges it. Use for PRs that were opened but not merged (stale, conflicting, or never reviewed). Pass the PR number.

frontmatter.name: releaser
frontmatter.description: Cuts and publishes a stable release of the Margin repo when the release gate passes (green CI, clean nightly for the same commit, cadence guards, no `no-release` kill switch). Run by /autopilot after a ship round when main has feat/fix commits since the last tag; does nothing when the gate fails.

frontmatter.name: autopilot
frontmatter.description: Run the Margin repo's whole agent workflow continuously — the triager in watch mode plus repeated /ship rounds — until stopped (or `--hours` runs out). Use when the owner invokes /autopilot or asks to "run everything" / "keep going on your own".

frontmatter.name: scout
frontmatter.description: Periodic read-only codebase scout for the Margin repo. Runs the test suites on main, checks CI/nightly, and looks for bugs, performance problems or missing features in what changed on main since its last scan and files issues for them. Run by /autopilot every ~3 h; skips if main has not moved.
